messages:
Nina: Quick note  just swapped slide 1 graphic to the updated timeline (uploaded as timeline-final).
Arjun: grabbing it. can AV confirm local recorder sees the new file?
ops-team: upload confirmed: /drive/allhands/timeline-final.pdf checksum OK
Ben (AV): heads up  mic A creaked during rehearsal. switching presenter to handheld B. doing a quick level check.
Maya: please bump captions weight and test a 1s resync after the slide flip. last time captions lagged.
Ben (AV): increasing font-weight to 700 and running quick resync: `sudo systemctl restart captions && captionctl sync --offset -100ms`
ops-team: caption sync returned OK, sample latency ~95ms
Nina: AV, also set recorder filename to include event+date so clips are easier to find.
ClipBot: recording pattern set: redwood-allhands-2026-03-23-final.mp4
Arjun: mic swap done, levels -6dB. I'm seeing a tiny pop on cut; adding 250ms crossfade.
Ben (AV): crossfade applied. preview looks clean.
Maya: Q&A process  leadership wants questions grouped by tag infra|console|dedicated. I'll queue them and read grouped. Hold until I say go.
Nina: we'll open Q&A after the roadmap slide. If audio fails, fallback to pre-recorded infra clip ID 9. AV preload?
Ben (AV): clip 9 preloaded to scene library, mapped to F9.
Arjun: small ops note  recorder host disk at 86%. we have enough for this session but please run `cleanup_tmp.sh` after.
ops-team: cleanup job scheduled post-session.
Nina: starting slides in 5..4..3.. go :sparkles:
Ben (AV): scene switched, captions live, handheld confirmed.
Maya: opening Q&A  first tag infra  question from @carmen about Dedicated GA timing. Nina?
Nina: quick answer: phased GA targeted for Q3; beta invites late Q2. detailed follow-up doc will land in #product.
Arjun: logged for follow-up.
Ben (AV): recorder rolling. no further AV issues.
Maya: closing Q&A shortly, will post grouped transcript + timestamps when processing finishes.
ClipBot: recording finalized and uploaded: /recordings/redwood-allhands-2026-03-23-final.mp4 (processing)
